title: Not Just RLHF: Why Alignment Alone Won’t Fix Multi-Agent Sycophancy
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic interpretability of sycophancy (conformity bias) in LLMs. While it utilizes the MMLU philosophy domain and ethical examples (e.g., Kantian ethics) as test data to measure how models flip from correct to incorrect answers under pressure, the study is an investigation of model alignment and activation-space circuits rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
